The '''Ash Plains''' were a desolate region of [[Lenico IV]]. Although largely uninhabited, there was a small [[Ortolan tribe|tribe]] of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] who occupied a [[Ortolan village|village]] within the wastes. The Plains were also stalked by a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] and were scattered with large statutes and ancient ruins. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the Ash Plains were visited by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] [[Exal Kressh]] and [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], as well as the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jerbhen Hulis]]. Later in the war, members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] participated in a [[Battle on the Ash Plains of Lenico IV|battle]] on the Ash Plains.
